operator.title: Data controller
operator.body: Personal data is processed by the Three Marks project team. For any question about data processing, including requests to access, correct or delete your data, write to <mail>{email}</mail>.

data.title: What data we process
data.body: When you sign in with Lesta ID: the Mir Tankov account ID and nickname and a Lesta API access token. If you provide or link them: your email address and your Telegram, Discord or VK IDs. If you bound the modpack: your battle results, your shots, tank loadouts, queue times, game settings (when you send them), replays (if you turned uploads on) and the device key. For the modpack plate the mod sends the account numbers of a battle’s players: the site keeps no copy of that list and, while the switch is on, keeps only a 30-day “mod installed” mark on your account. For the Plus subscription: its status and term and, once payments open, payment history; card data is handled by the payment provider, we never receive or store it. Public game statistics come from the open Lesta API.

purposes.title: Why
purposes.body: To show your statistics and analytics, keep your settings, goals and favorites, send the notifications you turned on, and run the Plus subscription.

basis.title: Legal basis
basis.body: The consent you give when you sign in and turn on notifications, and performance of the terms of use, under Russian Federal Law No. 152-FZ “On Personal Data”.

storage.title: Where data is stored
storage.body: Data is stored on rented servers (VPS) in the Russian Federation. We never sell it or use it for advertising.

retention.title: How long data is kept and how to delete it
retention.body: Account data is kept while the account exists. When you delete the account, its links, settings, notifications, API keys, modpack devices and your posts are deleted at once, and the linked game accounts are hidden from the site and no longer tracked at once; a background job then deletes their data. We delete a game account’s data the same way on Lesta Games’ request. If you later sign in with Lesta ID again, tracking of your account resumes. While the account exists, statistics history, modpack battle results and sessions are kept for up to 2 years, and notifications for 180 days. Database backups are overwritten in rotation and kept for up to 6 months. Subscription and payment records are kept as long as the law requires.

transfer.title: Who receives data
transfer.body: We do not share data with third parties, ad networks or search engines. The exceptions: Lesta Games, since Lesta ID sign-in runs over OpenID on their side and public statistics are requested from their open API by account number; and the payment provider, once payments open, only to process a payment. If you connected Telegram, Discord or VK yourself, notifications and reports are delivered through them.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can get a copy of your data, correct it, withdraw consent and delete your account in your account area (the Overview page). Send requests the interface cannot handle to <mail>{email}</mail>; we reply within 10 business days.

cookies.title: Cookies and local storage
cookies.body: The site has no analytics, ads or third-party trackers. Cookies: the sign-in session on the API domain (valid for 30 days and extended while you use the site); a signed random device ID to count free allowances without signing in, such as 3D armor views (up to 400 days); a temporary 10-minute cookie while you connect a streaming service; an interface language cookie if you switched the language. Browser local storage holds the sign-in token, theme, rating appearance, table settings, pinned tanks and maps, the comparison selection, your player, recent players and daily game progress; session storage holds a referral code until you sign up. This data stays in your browser and you can clear it in the browser settings.

privacyChanges.title: Changes to this policy
privacyChanges.body: Version of October 9, 2026. A new version is published on this page; for material changes we notify you on the site.

parties.title: Parties
parties.body: These terms are between the Three Marks project team and the user: anyone who uses the Three Marks site, modpack or modpack manager. Contact the team at <mail>{email}</mail>.

subject.title: Subject
subject.body: Three Marks is an unofficial fan-made statistics and tools service for Mir Tankov. It is not affiliated with Lesta Games; game data comes from the open Lesta API, and the rights to the game and its materials belong to Lesta Games. The core features are free.

account.title: Account
account.body: You sign in with Lesta ID or Telegram. We never receive or store your game password. You are responsible for actions taken in your account and can delete it at any time in your account area (the Overview page).

plus.title: The Plus subscription
plus.body: Three Marks Plus is a subscription that raises limits and unlocks extra features. Some features are free within a monthly allowance (for example 3D armor and detailed battle analysis); allowances follow the calendar month and renew on the 1st at 00:00 Moscow time. The subscription's contents and allowances are listed on the Plus page. Until payments open, Plus is only granted for free, as a trial and promo days.

payment.title: Payment
payment.body: Payments are not open yet and we charge nothing. Before they open, this section will list the prices, the payment provider and how payment, renewal and receipts work.

refund.title: Refunds
refund.body: You can cancel at any time, and access stays until the end of the paid period. We refund the unused days on request: write to <mail>{email}</mail> or the <bot>bot</bot>. The money goes back the way you paid, within 10 days of the request.

rules.title: Acceptable use
rules.body: Do not scrape the site around the public API, disrupt the service, publish other people’s data without consent, or break the Mir Tankov rules. The Three Marks modpack shows only your own data and what the game client already shows.

liability.title: Liability
liability.body: The service is provided “as is”. Statistics are computed from the Lesta API and may differ from in-game figures. We are not liable for Lesta API outages or for decisions made based on the statistics.

termsChanges.title: Changes to the terms
termsChanges.body: Version of October 9, 2026. A new version takes effect when published on this page. If a price changes, subscriptions already paid for get it only from the next period.

support.title: Three Marks support
support.body: Questions about the site, the mod, Plus and payments: <mail>{email}</mail> or our Telegram bot, <bot>@OtmetkiBot</bot>. We reply within 2 business days.

dataErrors.title: Wrong data
dataErrors.body: If statistics, tank characteristics or a build look wrong, write to <mail>{email}</mail> or the <bot>bot</bot> with a link to the page and what is off. We will check the calculation and fix it.

game.title: Game support (Lesta)
game.body: Game account questions, in-game purchases, bans and Lesta ID are handled only by Lesta Games support: <lesta>Lesta support center</lesta>. We cannot help with them because we are not affiliated with Lesta Games.
